bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 受阻于 $760，收盘跌破 $700

read.en: Micron fell 2.1% on Nov 19 to $690.44, trading $689.28–760, its lowest close since Nov 5. It is below the 5-day ($721.1) and 10-day ($736.4), both falling, the rising 200-day ($771.5), and the falling 30-day ($842.8) and 100-day ($924.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 30, below zero, histogram widening slightly; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($825.36), and RSI is 35.9.
read.zh: 美光 11月19日下跌 2.1%，收于 $690.44，盘中区间 $689.28–760，为 11月5日以来最低收盘。股价位于 5 日（$721.1）和 10 日均线（$736.4，均下行）、上行的 200 日均线（$771.5）以及下行的 30 日（$842.8）和 100 日均线（$924.8）下方。MACD 自 10月30日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图略有放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$825.36），RSI 为 35.9。

read.en: The $760 high cleared $740 intraday but reversed; the close broke the $699.6 support, now resistance, ending on the $687–690 band. Resistance is $699.6–705.3 (Nov 10 low, Nov 18 close), then $712–721 (5-day) and $736–746 (10-day, Nov 9–10 highs). Support is $687.3–690, then $667 (Nov 17 low) and $650 (Nov 5 low). A close above $705 would target $712–721; below $687, $667.

s.en: Nov 18 low $687.33; Nov 19 low $689.28; Nov 9 low $689.65; Nov 6 close $690
